title: etcd raft re-election survives 1-member loss; Patroni unaffected
description: Stops nexus-etcd.service on the current etcd leader (3-of-3 -> 2-of-3 still quorate). Verifies raft re-elects a new leader within ~5 s, Patroni's etcd3 client fails over transparently to a surviving endpoint, and PG service is uninterrupted (no Patroni-side primary change).

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.64 'sudo /usr/local/sbin/nexus-etcdctl endpoint status --cluster --write-out=json | jq -r ".[] | select(.Status.leader == .Status.header.member_id) | .Endpoint"'

observe.what: Endpoint URL of the current etcd raft leader (record as $ETCD_LEADER_URL; map back to etcd-1/2/3 IP)

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.61 'sudo /usr/local/sbin/nexus-patronictl list -f json | jq -r ".[] | select(.Role==\"Leader\") | .Member"'

observe.what: Current Patroni leader (record as $PG_LEADER_BEFORE; should NOT change after etcd-side failover)
Of the 2 surviving members, one shows IS LEADER=true (new raft leader elected within ~5 s); the killed member shows 'request failed' or absent
Log line 'raft: <id> became leader at term N+1' on the new leader

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.61 'sudo /usr/local/sbin/nexus-patronictl list -f json | jq -r ".[] | select(.Role==\"Leader\") | .Member"'

observe.what: Same value as $PG_LEADER_BEFORE -- Patroni's etcd3 client transparently re-targeted a surviving endpoint; PG primary unchanged
Patroni log may show transient 'etcd endpoint health check failed' warnings as the client retries the killed endpoint, but no DCS state change + no PG demote/promote
Restarted member rejoins as follower: 'raft: ... became follower at term N+1'

whatProves: etcd raft tolerates a 1-of-3 member loss (still 2/3 quorate); leader re-election completes within ~5 s (raft election timeout 1 s + transit overhead). Patroni's etcd3 client is endpoint-list-aware + fails over transparently to a surviving endpoint -- PG service is uninterrupted. The 3-member etcd quorum is the canonical lab fault tolerance: tolerates 1 failure; a 5-member quorum would tolerate 2.
